newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Friday that around 1,200 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Thursday.
Through Presidio, Texas, around 700 steer calves were sold at mostly steady prices compared to Wednesday. "Trade moderate, demand good, USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 94-104 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 84-94 cents/lb.
Through Laredo, Texas, around 500 head were sold at steady prices compared to Wednesday. "Trade moderate, demand moderate. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 93-103 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 83-93 cents/lb.
